name: Sweet Summer Harem!
source:
You are a young man feeling crushed under the weight of a city life. Deeply missing much happier times, you decide to reunite with your close ones and return to your hometown where many new and exciting adventures will await you!

Meet beautiful girls, develop relationships with them, go on dates, and follow the story that will lead to many romantic and lewd moments!

[From [url=https://fynnegun.itch.io/sweet-summer-harem]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名年輕男子，被城市生活的重壓壓得喘不過氣。懷念從前更加快樂的時光，你決定回到故鄉，與親近的人重聚。許多新鮮刺激的冒險，正等著你！

結識美麗的女孩，與她們發展關係、外出約會，跟隨故事經歷許多浪漫又香豔的時刻！

[摘自[url=https://fynnegun.itch.io/sweet-summer-harem]itch.io[/url]]
